errors.text: It attributes disappearance of the smallest particles primarily to Ostwald ripening/dissolution into larger particles, whereas the target mechanism emphasizes Au/Cu surface segregation followed by shell melting and evaporation.
It predicts evolution toward faceted structures, opposite to the observed elliptical-to-spherical reshaping.
The proposed approximately 5 nm, 600 K, 20 nm, and activation-energy boundaries are not supported by the cited evidence.
